Quote from Episode: he'd end up snaking their customers
台词翻译: 最后他总是把他们的客户撬走。
Example Sentence: The new hire spent a year poaching accounts from the old team.
例句翻译: 那个新人一整年从老团队挖客户。
Usage Note: 动词 snake 本义蛇行，引申为暗中抢夺（客户/人才）。

Quote from Episode: Last guy he ratted out was none other than his cousin
台词翻译: 他最后一个告发的人偏偏是他表哥。
Example Sentence: He ratted out his own supplier to save himself.
例句翻译: 他为了自保把供货商卖了。
Usage Note: rat＝卑劣小人／告密者。近义 squeal、inform on。

Quote from Episode: It turns out he's missing, presumed dead.
台词翻译: 结果是他人间蒸发，被列为推定死亡。
Example Sentence: The case has been closed as presumed dead since March.
例句翻译: 案子自三月起按推定死亡结案了。
Usage Note: 法律/公文用语。presume＝推定。missing presumed dead 是固定搭配。

Quote from Episode: Our chemist was blown away.
台词翻译: 我们那位化学家惊得说不出话。
Example Sentence: She was blown away by the sample purity.
例句翻译: 那份样本的纯度让她大吃一惊。
Usage Note: 被动式＝被震住。反义 blown off（被敷衍）。

释义（中文）: 超级实验室（大型隐秘实验室）
Quote from Episode: it didn't come out of some superlab in Mexico
台词翻译: 这可不是从墨西哥哪个超级实验室出来的。
Example Sentence: The trace suggested a domestic superlab, not an import.
例句翻译: 痕迹指向本土的超级实验室，不是进口货。
Usage Note: super- 前缀表示规模极大。犯罪语境专用。

Definition (EN): a place where drugs are manufactured
Quote from Episode: Car was abandoned at what appears to be a cook site.
台词翻译: 车被丢在一个看起来是制毒窝点的地方。
Example Sentence: Investigators found a cook site behind the warehouse.
例句翻译: 调查人员在仓库后面发现了一个制毒窝点。
Usage Note: cook 作动词＝制毒。fixed 住所叫 stash house / safe house。

Definition (EN): to be warned that you are being watched
Quote from Episode: So be on notice.
台词翻译: 所以你们给我当心点。
Example Sentence: Rivals were put on notice after the price war.
例句翻译: 价格战之后对手们都收到了警告。
Usage Note: 警告语气。put someone on notice／serve notice。

Word / Phrase: burn the shit out of someone
Definition (EN): to attack or outperform them fiercely
Quote from Episode: you're burning the shit out of them
台词翻译: 你这是往死里揍他们。
Example Sentence: Their team has been burning the hell out of the competition.
例句翻译: 他们队把对手打得毫无还手之力。
Usage Note: 非常粗俗。也可说 beat the shit out of（揍）。

Quote from Episode: Girls gotta be lining up left and right.
台词翻译: 姑娘们肯定排着队往这儿涌。
Example Sentence: Offers were lining up left and right by Friday.
例句翻译: 到周五各种邀约已经纷至沓来。
Usage Note: 字面「左右排开」。也作 coming out of the woodwork。

Definition (EN): how a woman would view the situation
Quote from Episode: That's a female perspective.
台词翻译: 这就是所谓的女性视角。
Example Sentence: He asks a male client to check it with a female perspective.
例句翻译: 他让男客户拿「女性视角」再掂量一下。
Usage Note: 职场谈体验/评审时常用。近义 consumer's eye。

Definition (EN): to keep asking them for it
Quote from Episode: I kept bugging her for a date.
台词翻译: 我一直在缠着她要约会。
Example Sentence: He bugged accounting for the numbers for a week.
例句翻译: 他缠着会计要数据要了一星期。
Usage Note: bug 作动词＝纠缠、烦。名词 a bug＝纠缠。

Quote from Episode: It was before they tightened the stalking laws.
台词翻译: 那还是他们收紧跟踪骚扰法之前。
Example Sentence: Regulators tightened the law on influencer disclosure.
例句翻译: 监管机构收紧了网红广告披露的法规。
Usage Note: tighten up on sth＝加强。名词 tightening。

Quote from Episode: I chased your Aunt Marie here all over creation.
台词翻译: 我当时满城追你玛丽姨妈。
Example Sentence: He's been all over creation looking for the receipt.
例句翻译: 他满世界找那张收据。
Usage Note: 老式口语＝everywhere。近义 all over the shop（满店都是）。

Definition (EN): to decide firmly that you will get it
Quote from Episode: Once you set your cap for something, or somebody
台词翻译: 一旦你盯上了什么东西或者什么人。
Example Sentence: She set her cap on the managing director role.
例句翻译: 她打定主意要拿下总经理的位子。
Usage Note: 19世纪戏服「向某人求婚」。语气执着，有时含轻蔑。

Definition (EN): to be capable of achieving it
Quote from Episode: I'll bet you didn't think your old man had it in him
台词翻译: 我敢说你没觉得你老子有这本事。
Example Sentence: He's slow but he has it in him.
例句翻译: 他慢，但他有那个能力。
Usage Note: 谈能力/毅力。相似 have what it takes。

Quote from Episode: Confidence and and persistence.
台词翻译: 自信，加上坚持。
Example Sentence: Persistence beat talent in the end.
例句翻译: 最后是坚持打败了天赋。
Usage Note: 形容词 persistent；动词 persist in＝坚持做。反义 give up。注意原文引文里 and 重复了两次，是字幕转写重复，不是你的重点。

Definition (EN): to realise what is really happening
Quote from Episode: And once I caught on to that
台词翻译: 等我察觉到这一点之后……
Example Sentence: It took him a month to catch on to the pricing change.
例句翻译: 他花了一个月才察觉调价了。
Usage Note: get the hang of＝掌握窍门；catch on＝想明白。

Quote from Episode: How do they think they can get away with this?
台词翻译: 他们以为这样就能蒙混过关？
Example Sentence: He got away with it because nobody checked.
例句翻译: 因为没人核查，他蒙混过去了。
Usage Note: 后接 it／sth。get away with murder 是习语（逍遥法外）。

Quote from Episode: Certainly a second opinion, right?
台词翻译: 肯定要找个专家再看一次，对吧？
Example Sentence: Always get a second opinion before surgery.
例句翻译: 手术前一定要找第二个医生看看。
Usage Note: 医疗通用；也用于「再听听别人的意见」。

Definition (EN): the branch of medicine dealing with cancer
Quote from Episode: we find you the best the oncology dream team
台词翻译: 我们给你找最好的肿瘤科梦之队。
Example Sentence: She moved into oncology after a fellowship.
例句翻译: 她做完研究fellowship 转去做肿瘤了。
Usage Note: 形容词 oncological。发音「昂-科勒-吉」。

Definition (EN): to be so obvious it need not be stated
释义（中文）: 不言而喻；不用说也知道
Quote from Episode: I hope this goes without saying
台词翻译: 这件事我想不用我说了吧。
Example Sentence: That he lied goes without saying.
例句翻译: 他撒谎了，这一点不言而喻。
Usage Note: 正式。反义 it needs saying。

Quote from Episode: These are mad tight.
台词翻译: 这些真是顶呱呱。
Example Sentence: His new album is mad tight.
例句翻译: 他的新专辑牛得不行。
Usage Note: 俚语（黑人英语），年轻人常用。反义 mad trash。

Definition (EN): you are the one suffering from refusing
释义（中文）: 那是你不领情／是你的损失
Quote from Episode: Your loss.
台词翻译: 那是你不识货。
Example Sentence: They passed on the offer? Their loss.
例句翻译: 他们没接那个offer？那是他们亏了。
Usage Note: 轻蔑或调侃。也可指真正的「损失」。

Quote from Episode: It's been caving in left and right.
台词翻译: 房子到处都在塌。
Example Sentence: The retaining wall started caving in after the rain.
例句翻译: 雨后挡土墙开始往里塌。
Usage Note: 建筑/地质描述。反义 bulge out（鼓出去）。

Definition (EN): to pay to release them from custody
Quote from Episode: His cousin bailed him out.
台词翻译: 是他表哥交保释金把他弄出来的。
Example Sentence: His parents had to bail him out twice.
例句翻译: 他父母两次花钱把他保出来。
Usage Note: 名词 bail＝保释金。也可指财务上替人解围。

Quote from Episode: He skipped town or something.
台词翻译: 他好像是跑路了什么的。
Example Sentence: He skipped town the day the audit landed.
例句翻译: 审计下来的当天他就跑了。
Usage Note: take to the hills 属同义俚语。名词 a skip town。

Quote from Episode: I've been kinda doing my own thing these days
台词翻译: 我最近算是自己单干了。
Example Sentence: After the split she just did her own thing.
例句翻译: 拆伙以后她就自己干了。
Usage Note: 非常常用。近义 go it alone。

Definition (EN): to want to use some drugs
Quote from Episode: I could seriously go for a bowl.
台词翻译: 我是真想来一口。
Example Sentence: After the week I had, I could really go for a bowl.
例句翻译: 熬过这一周，我是真想来一口。
Usage Note: 俚语。bowl＝一管／一炉的量。反义 pass（在下一集用过了）。

Quote from Episode: Take the edge off.
台词翻译: 缓一缓吧。
Example Sentence: A walk took some of the edge off.
例句翻译: 散了会儿步，火气消了些。
Usage Note: edge＝紧张感／锐度。take the edge off＝让…不那么紧绷。

Definition (EN): to stop using or doing something
Quote from Episode: I'll just lay off of it for a while.
台词翻译: 我先停一阵子。
Example Sentence: He laid off the stimulants after the diagnosis.
例句翻译: 确诊之后他把兴奋剂停了。
Usage Note: 职场义＝裁员。药瘾语境＝戒断，此处是前者混淆但都常见。

Definition (EN): to tell someone to go away
Quote from Episode: just tell us to piss off
台词翻译: 你就直说让我们滚蛋不就完了。
Example Sentence: If you don't want to share, just piss off.
例句翻译: 你要是不想分享，那就别来烦我们。
Usage Note: 粗俗。名词 piss-off＝让人恼火的人。

释义（中文）: 狗血剧情；家长里短的闹剧
Quote from Episode: We don't need no soap opera.
台词翻译: 我们不要搞这套狗血剧情。
Example Sentence: The board didn't sign up for a soap opera.
例句翻译: 董事会可不想要一场狗血大戏。
Usage Note: 引申义与字面（肥皂剧）差距很大，职场指情绪化的纠缠。

Definition (EN): to squeeze them into a busy schedule
Quote from Episode: Thank you so much for working us in.
台词翻译: 太感谢您挤时间安排我们了。
Example Sentence: Can you work us in on Thursday?
例句翻译: 周四能给我们挤个时间吗？
Usage Note: 常指医院/美发/服务行业把客人插进空档。反义 squeeze in。

Definition (EN): to help them when it mattered
释义（中文）: 帮了大忙；关键时刻顶上
Quote from Episode: Marie really came through for us.
台词翻译: 玛丽真是帮了我们大忙。
Example Sentence: She came through for the team on the last deal.
例句翻译: 最后一单她替团队顶了下来。
Usage Note: 近义 pull through（挺过去）；come through＝最终成功。

Quote from Episode: From here on out, things are gonna
台词翻译: 从今往后，事情会……
Example Sentence: From here on out we brief in writing.
例句翻译: 从现在起我们都用书面同步。
Usage Note: ≈ from now on。正式度高于 going forward。
